mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX posts negative 60-day returns in > 40% of subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 5% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 5% but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the year-over-year change in the industrial production index, signals a supply shock that will drive inflation and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y INDPRO growth falls by > 3pp but SPX posts positive 60-day returns in > 40% of subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the federal funds rate above 3% signals a tightening monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 3% but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales, as measured by the year-over-year change in real retail sales, signals a weakening consumer sector that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y RSAFS growth falls by > 5pp but SPX posts positive 60-day returns in > 40% of subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating pace of job growth, as measured by the 3-month change in nonfarm payrolls, signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 3-mo change in PAYEMS accelerates by > 100k jobs/mo but SPX posts negative 20-day returns in > 40% of subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in housing starts signals an improving housing market that will boost related sectors and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises by > 10% y-o-y but SPX posts negative 60-day returns in > 40% of subsequent months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the consumer price index above 3% signals rising inflation expectations that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises above 3% but SPX posts positive 20-day returns in > 60% of subsequent months.
